effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` eUSD (0xCfA3…9FB4) from their wallet to the vault (safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)).
The receiver gets meUSD vault shares, computed from `assets` at the current exchange rate after fee accrual, rounded down; no minimum is enforced.
The vault spends the signer's eUSD allowance to the vault by `assets`.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", then the eUSD amount deposited, the share ticker "meUSD" and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many meUSD shares the receiver gets, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The share count comes from storage, not from calldata. The descriptor shows only `"label": "Share ticker", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"`.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the computed share amount. Leave as is.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" names neither the asset nor the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, with no interpolatedIntent. The token eUSD and the vault meUSD appear only in the fields.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit eUSD into meUSD vault" and add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deposit {assets} to receive meUSD shares for {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends eUSD to the vault. The amount is computed from `shares` at the current exchange rate after fee accrual, rounded up. The only bound is the signer's eUSD allowance to the vault.
The receiver gets exactly `shares` meUSD vault shares.
The vault spends the signer's eUSD allowance to the vault by the computed amount.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", the label "Deposit asset: eUSD" with no amount, the exact meUSD shares minted, and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint does not show how much eUSD leaves the signer's wallet; the field shows only the ticker.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. The descriptor shows `"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`. That renders "eUSD" with no amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the eUSD amount. Leave as is, or relabel the ticker field "Pays with (amount set by vault rate)".

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say that the signer pays eUSD for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`. The code pulls eUSD from the caller in ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit eUSD to mint meUSD shares".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns meUSD shares from `owner`. The share amount is computed from `assets` at the current exchange rate, rounded up.
When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's meUSD share allowance from `owner` by that share amount.
The receiver gets exactly `assets` eUSD from the vault.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", the exact eUSD amount to withdraw, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many meUSD shares the vault burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`. No field shows the shares.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the share amount. Leave as is.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" names neither the asset nor the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`, with no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw eUSD from meUSD vault".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` meUSD shares from `owner`.
When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's meUSD share allowance from `owner` by `shares`.
The receiver gets eUSD from the vault. The amount is computed from `shares` at the current exchange rate, rounded down, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the exact meUSD shares to redeem, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: redeem does not show the eUSD the receiver gets, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);`. No field names eUSD or the amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the eUSD amount. To name the asset, add a constant field: {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}.

findings.title: redeem intent "Redeem" does not say that the shares become eUSD.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: `"intent": "Redeem"`. None of its fields mentions eUSD.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem meUSD shares for eUSD".
